title: Acetone Extraction of Bacteria Pellet for HPLC
author: Team Fudan iGEM

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 150 mL of 2×YT medium and incubate overnight at the appropriate temperature for the strain.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight culture at 4000 rpm for 10 minutes, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add cold acetone
steps.instruction: Add 4 × the sample volume of acetone pre‑chilled to –20 °C (e.g., 3 mL in the example) to the pellet/extract and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the acetone‑treated sample at –20 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge extraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 500 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C and collect the supernatant without disturbing the protein pellet.

steps.title: Store extracted sample
steps.instruction: Store the acetone‑extracted supernatant at –80 °C for long‑term storage or at –20 °C for short‑term use.
